answer: On the silversmith's bench the cups stand in a row, each one waiting for the hallmark that proves it true. Proof of miller sack via stone grind log is the hallmarking: a sack the miller grinds only after 7 stones turn true, each stone dressed by the miller himself. The jetty is the first mark, struck when the silver was annealed; the lotus is the sixth, struck when the cup was finished. A cheat must strike 21 false marks and anneal 21 false cups, and the shale still pours no wine.
